test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully and decide which of the given conclusions logically follow from these statements.

Statements:

I. I have not read all the seven Harry Potter books yet.

II. I have read all the books of Jane Austen.

III. I do not like reading self-help books, though I have read some of them for novelty.

Conclusions:

i. Though reading books is my hobby, I read only selective books.

ii. I have read some of the Harry Potter books.

iii. I like to experiment in choosing my next book.
solution:
Given,

Statements:

I. I have not read all the seven Harry Potter books yet.

II. I have read all the books of Jane Austen.

III. I do not like reading self-help books, though I have read some of them for novelty.

Conclusions:

i. Though reading books is my hobby, I read only selective books - False (Because, the statements does not indicate the preference for certain books while avoiding others, suggesting selective reading habits).

ii. I have read some of the Harry Potter books - **True **(Because, the statement "I have not read all the seven Harry Potter books yet" implies that some of the Harry Potter books have been read).

iii. I like to experiment in choosing my next book - **True **(Because, the statement "I do not like reading self-help books, though I have read some of them for novelty" suggests a willingness to experiment with different genres).

So, Only conclusions (ii) and (iii) follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
